text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the shopping
district with Symboli Kris S...

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Lady
text_block_list.text: Good grief, so much left over? Well, the rain kept the customers away, after all...

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
"It's getting late...
Guess we've got no choice but to throw it out..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Symboli Kris S's gaze was fixed on a bento shop. There were many unsold bentos displayed in the storefront.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Shopkeeper.
...Those boxed lunches... I would like to buy them all.

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Lady
text_block_list.text: Huh!? A-All of them!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...Failing to fulfill one's duty is—painful.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I will—make sure the mission is fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
"...A-A mission...? 
I don't really get it, but thanks a bunch! Much obliged!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us ended up
taking home a mountain of bento boxes, but—
choice_data_list: What are you gonna do with this boxed lunch?
What are you going to do with this boxed lunch?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I will eat it—before the day ends.
That is the mission—of a bento.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she intends to eat it all to fulfill the bento's purpose.
—That being said, it's quite a massive portion.
choice_data_list: Why not ask someone to help you?
If you eat it all up, the bento box will be happy too!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Returning to the dorm, Symboli Kris S spread out a boxed lunch on the dining hall table.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! There are so many lunches...!
Fried chicken, and hamburger steaks...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
They all look delicious.
That being said, it's quite an impressive amount.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —If it's all right with you, I'd like you to eat this.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah. There's plenty—no need to hold back.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then... thank you for the food.
Ehehe, thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying on like this, Symboli Kris S enlisted everyone's help
and fulfilled the bento's mission.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Mm. ...Let us partake and enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for the food.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: *Munch, munch*... I have... honorably fulfilled... my duty...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Symboli Kris S completely devoured
the massive pile of bento boxes.
